journalItems.text: Save and provide quality antiques for customers seeking to purchase a piece of history and art of their own.
Authentically collecting & cleaning up pieces using various techniques without ruining the patina. Pieces in the showroom will show a Restored badge showing which item was restored and how.
Pricing is based off of recently sold listings and local/online market prices. I believe in offers so fair offers and bundle deals are considered!
Initial pictures of items will NOT be enhanced by AI in anyway with the exception of the last picture in the carousel showing a staging use concept if needed.

customTexts.ethosLead: Part of what I do is offer  a service to help go through and assess items (Ex: A loved ones home items or assets left behind) and help sell or give direction on ways to make money for clients and their families. There are no upfront costs! Profits for each item sold is split 50/50 after platform fees and taxes.
customTexts.ethosCard1Desc: When beneficial, a good cleaning with mineral spirits, ultra sonic bath, and or delicate paint stripping apply
customTexts.ethosCard2Desc: Mortise locks, Architectual Salvage, lamps, etc are all inspected, rewired or lubricated on most pieces. Vintage electronics are verified working before being listed unless specified otherwise
customTexts.ethosCard3Desc: I like to preserve original warm age patina and style while protecting surfaces for decades to come—using hand applied clear wax, linseed oils, and appropriate oil based rust preventatives.

products.title: Vintage 5-Gallon Italian Beverage Dispenser | Heavy Green Glass Party Drink Jar with Brass Spicket
products.description: Very clean with no chips or cracks. Decorative hexagon vintage green glass made in italy is perfect for serving parties, BBQs, home dinners and get togethers. Fits a whole 5 gallons and can be used for steeping fruits and lemons in water as well!

products.title: Antique Signed Royal Doulton David Dewsbury Orchid Cabinet Plate Dendrobium Gold
products.description:
Up for sale is an extraordinary, museum-grade piece of English ceramic art: an authentic antique Royal Doulton shallow cabinet bowl / coupe dish, hand-painted and artist-signed by Royal Doulton’s preeminent master orchid painter, David Dewsbury.  
Dewsbury was globally celebrated throughout the late Victorian and Edwardian eras for his botanical orchid studies executed at Doulton's Burslem studios. This piece features a lifelike central study of "Dendrobium Phalaenopsis" orchids, beautifully framed by a wide border of heavy, raised acid-etched 24K gold foliate rococo scrolls, delicate floral swags, and a scalloped fluted gadrooned rim. Signed by the artist within the artwork.

products.title: Vintage Hand Carved Pig Folk Art Kitchen Cutting Board
products.description: Unique hand carved pig with larger finger handle/hanger tail and eye inclusion. Original use patina with old cut patterns (visible but smoothed out during restoration to preserve character but make it useable).
products.restoration: Cleaned and food grade waxed. Ready to be freshly used in the kitchen once again with style.

products.title: Framed Original Thai Temple Stone Rubbing Elephant Battle Scene on Mulberry(Sa)  Paper
products.description: Crafted between 1960 and 1975 during the mid-century tourism surge in Bangkok. Made with pressed Mulberry paper and rubbed over temple stone reliefs, The Thai government eventually outlawed direct rubbings to preserve ancient stone reliefs from physical damage, making authentic mid-century examples desirable

products.title: 1933 Emery Whilton Herbarium Framed Print California Honeysuckle Cyanotype Blue
products.description:
Up for sale is a rare and striking original 1933 botanical cyanotype-style herbarium print by renowned California naturalist and collector Emery Whilton. This piece showcases a detailed specimen of California Honeysuckle (Lonicera hispidula), originally prepared on June 17, 1933, complete with the vintage printed specimen plate label detailing its botanical classification and collection data.   
Rendered in rich Prussian blue tones against naturally aged paper, this piece carries stunning cottagecore, modern organic, and vintage botanical gallery-wall appeal. It comes professionally framed under glass in a classic silver-finish wooden frame, ready to hang and display immediately.

products.title: Rare Cornelius Sullivan Original 19”x25” Study Drawing/Sketch Concept “Winona Reading”
Set of 4 Vtg Mid Century Hitchcock Style Colonial Painted Country Dining Chairs Cottagecore
products.description: Up for sale are these rare beautiful weathered set of 4 mid century matching Hitchcock style colonial painted scene chippy paint chairs. Perfect for cottage core aesthetic, breakfast nook chairs, farmhouse, or vintage. Featuring muted green paint, sturdy level construction, and painted motiffs. These are weathered chippy paint so there will be use patina, chips and other aesthetic cracklings (saved on purpose)
products.restoration: These chairs were wiped with mineral spirits and a fresh coat of clear paste wax applied to seal and protect but also bring out the colors.

products.title: Vintage 1960s Gone With The Wind Parlor Hurricane Lamp Blue Fruit Grapes 3-Way Glass
products.description: Up for sale is a classic mid-century electric Gone With The Wind (GWTW) style parlor hurricane lamp. Featuring a stunning double-globe design adorned with hand-painted blue grapes and fruit motifs against a satin white background, this lamp delivers incredible ambiance for vintage, Victorian, and farmhouse decor settings.
products.restoration: Fresh wax on cast metal to preserve it. Wiped down glass and added new bulbs
